newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Mainfreight lifts 9 mth pre-tax profit.
newsitem.headline: Mainfreight lifts 9 mth pre-tax profit.

text.p: Transport group Mainfreight Ltd said on Wednesday its group net profit before float costs, taxation and minority interests in the nine months to December 31 had risen 30.9 percent to NZ$7.74 million.
The directors said several strategic acquisitions were currently under evaluation. The company remained open opportunities which compliment its existing activities.
The company said the nine-month result reinforced directors' confidence the NZ$5.5 million forecast net profit for the 1997 financial year would be achieved.

-the departure of a large warehousing customer during the third quarter, as forecast and disclosed in the Mainfreight prospectus on May 6, 1996. -an unseasonably wet spring, which resulted in lower volumes in agricultural and building related freight volumes; and
-lower retail sale volumes during November and December.
However, the company said it was satisfied with the results achieved in the third quarter.
Operating margins (excluding Lep) improved to 10.4 percent, compared to 9.6 percent on the previous comparable period.
"The group's financial position remains strong with shareholders equity of $23.3 million funding 40.5 percent of total assets," Mainfreight said.
"The first nine months result reinforces the directors' confidence that the forecast earnings for the 1997 financial year as detailed in the prospectus will be achieved."
